look_here_first: Decumbent whitish stems, unusually soft long pubescence, distinctly white/silvery lower leaf surfaces, and red to red-pink flowers.

lookalikes.differences: Use the very soft long hairs, silvery abaxial surface, decumbent habit, and distribution together; flower color alone is not enough.

source_credit: Existing Hays Botany species record and scientific source notes; original full record retained in assigned family staging branch
